behaviour_preserved_and_verified.no_code_change: The complete source closure of scd, netd, portald and acctd was identical between the commit each ran and master before the rebuild: zero changed files for all four. edged and pmsd were already at master's content.
behaviour_preserved_and_verified.enforcement_untouched: The nftables state is IDENTICAL across the netd restart: 6 sets and 63 rules before and after, with the same elements -- walled_garden_ip 3, guest_interfaces 1, guest_subnets 1, auth_ipv4 and phase3_auth_ipv4 empty. netd's boot reconcile re-asserted the plane exactly.
behaviour_preserved_and_verified.guest_state: 475 in-house stays before and after. Zero open guest sessions before and after.
behaviour_preserved_and_verified.favourable_window: The rebuild was performed while auth_ipv4 was empty and no tc class existed, i.e. with no guest currently enforced -- checked before starting, not assumed. Restarting scd, netd and portald therefore disturbed no live guest.
behaviour_preserved_and_verified.services: All seven active after: scd, edged, pmsd, portald, netd, acctd, hotel-admin.

pms_reconnect_caused_by_the_deployment.what: Restarting pmsd dropped and re-established the PMS link; the connector requested its own resync, as it does after any reconnect. No operator command was issued.
pms_reconnect_caused_by_the_deployment.outcome: Settled to IN_SYNC/COMPLETE on generation 284. Transport CONNECTED, continuity CONTINUOUS throughout.

on_appliance_provenance_records.DEPLOYED_SHA: Updated to f6a24e6cd5a8f0b5b75e86b43d69bd7b1b51f8aa. It had read 480fd213 since 2026-09-06 and was wrong for every binary by the time this mission began.
on_appliance_provenance_records.DEPLOYED_BINARIES.txt: NEW. Records the sha256 of every service binary with the exact recipe that produced them and the two commands that re-verify any line. It was immediately checked with `sha256sum -c`: all six OK.
on_appliance_provenance_records.why_a_manifest_and_not_just_a_head: A single head was the previous record, and it silently stopped describing four of six binaries. A per-binary manifest cannot drift quietly: it is either checkable or it fails.

rollback.digests: scd f6da65a0, edged 7509f6af, pmsd ff4dadcb, portald 6f135310, netd 134e7782, acctd 56cb2b11 -- the exact binaries that were running before this deployment.
rollback.procedure: Copy the .prev back over /opt/stayconnect/bin/<svc> and restart that unit. Per service, independently.
rollback.caveat_stated_plainly: Rolling back portald or acctd restores a binary whose provenance is unproven or absent. That is the state this mission existed to end, so a rollback of those two should be treated as a temporary measure with a known defect, not a return to a good state.
